businessGoal: Enhance product browsing experience with pagination

scenarios.goal: Verify that pagination controls are displayed when there are more products than fit on one page
Verify that clicking a page number updates the product grid to show products for that page
Verify that the current page number is visually highlighted after page navigation

manual.reason: The story describes UI behavior that needs to be tested manually.

api.reason: There is no indication that pagination behavior can be validated through the API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria involve visible elements and user interaction with the UI.
